actions.description: Pipettes with tips are hanging on a rack; hand approaches the rightmost/yellow-button pipette.
Gloved hand grasps the rightmost pipette and removes it from the rack; a tip is already attached.
Pipette is carried downward/forward over the bench area toward tube/tip racks; no aspiration or dispensing is visible.
Pipette is held above a red rack/box area; tip remains attached, with no visible liquid handling.
Pipette is moved back upward toward the rack area; tip still attached.

surface.evidence: The tip is not visibly touching the bench, glove, tube exterior, or other non-sterile surface.

release.evidence: No tip drop, ejection, or unexpected release is visible.

install.evidence: The attached tip appears seated and aligned; no visible wrong-size or loose fit.

output.overall_summary: The clip shows a gloved hand taking a pipette with an attached tip from a rack, moving it around the bench area, and raising it back toward the rack. No aspiration, dispensing, tip ejection, surface contact, or clear technique error is visible.
